s2_temp_unique_001_1.desc: When you take damage from a Non-Physical damage type, you gain {c_random}+[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} Maximum Resistance to that damage type for {c_number}6{/c} seconds. This effect can only apply to one damage type at a time.

s2_temp_unique_002_1.desc: When you gain {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c} while already Berserk, you have a {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} chance to become more enraged granting {c_number}15%{c_gray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage, {c_number}2{/c} Fury per second, and {c_number}10%{/c} Cooldown Reduction.

s2_temp_unique_003_1.desc: Casting {c_important}Boulder{/c} while {c_important}Hurricane{/c} is active will cause your boulders to rotate around you.

s2_temp_unique_004_1.desc: While you have unlimited Energy from {c_important}Inner Sight{/c}, your {c_important}Core{/c} Skills have a {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} chance to spawn {c_important}Caltrops{/c}, {c_important}Poison Trap{/c}, or {c_important}Death Trap{/c}.

s2_temp_unique_005_1.desc: Your Minions have a {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} chance to curse enemies. Enemies affected by at least {c_number}1{/c} of your curses take {c_number}70%{c_gray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} damage from you.

s2_temp_unique_006_1.desc: {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Damaging an enemy has up to a {c_number}30%{/c} chance of forming an exploding {c_important}Ice Spike{/c}, dealing {c_random}[Affix_Flat_Value_1||]{/c} Cold damage. Triple this chance if the enemy is {c_important}{u}Frozen{/u}{/c}.

s2_temp_unique_007_1.desc: When you Stun, {c_important}{u}Freeze{/u}{/c}, or Immobilize an Elite enemy, or damage a Boss, it pulls in nearby enemies. You deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{c_gray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage to them for {c_number}3{/c} seconds. This effect can only occur once every {c_number}12{/c} seconds.

s2_temp_unique_008_1.desc: Each enemy you {c_important}Evade{/c} through reduces your active {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Cooldown by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1||]{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}10{/c} seconds.

s2_temp_unique_009_1.desc: You deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{c_gray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage while {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} and for {c_number}4{/c} seconds after. When you become {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c}, gain {c_number}50{/c} of your Primary Resource.

s2_temp_unique_010_1.desc: {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Your damage over time effects have up to a {c_number}50%{/c} chance to erupt, dealing {c_random}[Affix_Flat_Value_1||]{/c} damage of the same type to Nearby enemies.

s2_temp_unique_011_1.desc: Your Healing Potion no longer Heals instantly, instead it grants a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} for {c_number}200%{/c} of the healing for {c_number}4{/c} seconds. While you have a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c}, you gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction.

s2_temp_unique_012_1.desc: After you spend {c_number}300{/c} of your Primary Resource, your next {c_important}Core{/c} Skill is guaranteed to {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c}. Your Critical Strikes that {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{c_gray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage.

s2_temp_generic_001.desc: You gain {c_number}20%{/c} Movement Speed. Lose this bonus for {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1|]{/c} seconds after taking damage.

s2_temp_generic_002.desc:
Gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{c_gray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} increased damage to a set of damage types for 7 seconds. This effect alternates between 2 sets:
{icon:bullet,1.2} Fire, Lightning and Physical.
{icon:bullet,1.2} Cold, Poison and Shadow.

s2_temp_barb_001.desc: Your {c_important}Rupture{/c} does not remove the Bleeding damage from enemies. This can occur once every {c_random}[Affix_Value_1||]{/c} seconds.

s2_temp_druid_001.desc: After you hit {c_number}15{/c} enemies with your {c_important}Werebear{/c} Skills, your next {c_important}Werebear{/c} Skill will deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{c_gray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} more damage and Stun enemies for {c_number}2{/c} seconds.

s2_temp_necro_001.desc: {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Your Shadow Damage Over Time effects have a {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} chance to generate {c_number}3{/c} Essence. Damage from your {c_important}Shadowblight{/c} Key Passive will always generate {c_number}2{/c} Essence.

s2_temp_rogue_001.desc: When you spend {c_number}100{/c} Energy you release a cluster of exploding {c_important}Stun Grenades{/c} that deal {c_random}[Affix_Flat_Value_1||]{/c} total Physical damage and Stun enemies for {c_number}0.5{/c} seconds. Your {c_important}Grenade{/c} Skills deal {c_number}15%{c_gray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} more damage.

s2_temp_sorc_001.desc: {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} When your {c_important}Conjuration{/c} Skills hit you have up to a {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} chance to gain {c_number}+1{/c} Rank to your {c_important}Conjuration{/c} skills for {c_number}12{/c} seconds. This can stack up to {c_number}3{/c} times.

s2m_temp_unique_001_1.desc: Casting a {c_important}Subterfuge{/c} Skill leaves behind a {c_important}Decoy Trap{/c} that continuously Taunts and lures enemies. The {c_important}Decoy Trap{/c} explodes after {c_number}3{/c} seconds dealing {c_random}[Affix_Flat_Value_1||]{/c} Shadow damage. Can occur every {c_number}12{/c} seconds.

s2m_temp_unique_002_1.desc: For each type of Elemental damage you deal, gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}4{/c} seconds. Dealing Elemental damage refreshes all bonuses.

s2m_temp_unique_003_1.desc: After spending {c_number}100{/c} Fury within {c_number}3{/c} seconds, your next cast of {c_important}Hammer of the Ancients{/c}, {c_important}Upheaval{/c}, or {c_important}Death Blow{/c} is a guaranteed Critical Strike and deals {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} bonus Critical Strike Damage.

s2m_temp_unique_004_1.desc: When casting an {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill and again {c_number}5{/c} seconds after, you Pull in Distant enemies and deal {c_random}[Affix_Flat_Value_1||]{/c} Physical damage to them. This damage is increased by {c_number}[1|1%x|]{/c} per {c_number}1{/c} point of Willpower you have.

s2m_temp_unique_005_1.desc:
You automatically activate the following equipped Skills on Corpses around you: 
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Raise Skeleton{/c} every {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1|]{/c} seconds. 
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Corpse Explosion{/c} every {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1|]{/c} seconds. 
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Corpse Tendrils{/c} every {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*4||]{/c} seconds.

s3_temp_unique_generic_001_1.desc: Damaging enemies with a cast Non-Basic Skill marks them for {c_number}3{/c} seconds. When a Basic Skill first hits a marked enemy, the Basic Skill's damage is echoed to all marked enemies, dealing {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage.

s3_temp_unique_generic_002_1.desc: Spending resources reduces your resource costs and increases your damage by {c_number}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} for {c_number}3{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}40%{/c}.

s3_temp_unique_generic_003_1.desc: Gain {c_number}[Affix_Value_1||]{/c} maximum Resource. {c_number}75%{/c} of incoming damage drains {c_number}2{/c} Resource for every {c_number}1%{/c} of Life you would have lost instead.

s3_temp_unique_barb_004_1.desc: Rend's duration is increased by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1|]{/c} seconds. Damaging enemies with Brawling Skills applies {c_number}2{/c} stacks of Rend's Bleed. This effect can only occur once every {c_number}4{/c} seconds per enemy.

s3_temp_unique_druid_005_1.desc: Lightning Storm gains {c_number}1{/c} additional strike each time it grows. Lightning Storm Critical Strikes cause lightning to strike twice, dealing {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} increased damage.

s3_temp_unique_necro_006_1.desc: You are Blood Lanced, and when Blood Lance would deal damage to you it instead Fortifies you for {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life and has a {c_number}5%{/c} chance to form a Blood Orb. Blood Lance deals {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*10|%x|]{/c} increased damage.

s3_temp_unique_rogue_007_1.desc: When you cast an Ultimate skill, your next Core skill consumes all of your energy and deals {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1%|]{/c} increased damage per Energy consumed. Using a Cooldown restores {c_number}5{/c} energy.

s3_temp_unique_sorc_008_1.desc: Meteor now has {c_number}2{/c} charges and a {c_random}[Affix_Value_1||]{/c} second Charge Cooldown instead of a Mana cost and drops {c_number}3{/c} additional meteors around the target. Meteor's Enchantment effect and Enhanced Meteor drop {c_number}1{/c} additional meteor.

s3_temp_aspect_generic_001.desc:
When cast below {c_number}50%{/c} Maximum Resource, Basic Skills generate {c_number}3{/c} of your Primary Resource, once per cast.
When cast at or above {c_number}50%{/c} Maximum Resource, Basic Skills deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} increased damage.

s3_temp_aspect_generic_002.desc: Gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|2|]{/c} Armor, but your Evade has {c_number}100%{/c} increased Cooldown.

s3_temp_aspect_barb_003.desc: Every {c_number}25{/c} seconds, Upheaval is guaranteed to Overpower and deals {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} increased damage. This timer is reduced by {c_number}4{/c} seconds when Upheaval Overpowers a Boss or an Elite enemy.

s3_temp_aspect_druid_004.desc: When Rabies infects an enemy, reduce its cooldown by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1|]{/c} seconds. This cooldown reduction is tripled when infecting Elites.

s3_temp_aspect_necro_005.desc: Casting Bone Spirit also launches {c_number}18{/c} Bone Splinters in all directions, dealing {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} increased damage and generating {c_number}6{/c} Essence per enemy hit.

s3_temp_aspect_rogue_006.desc: Breaking Concealment grants {c_number}[10|%+|]{/c} Resistance and Maximum Resist to all elements for {c_number}4{/c} seconds. Killing an Elite enemy reduces Concealment's cooldown by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1||]{/c} seconds.

s3_temp_aspect_sorc_007.desc: Ice Blades's chance to apply Vulnerable is increased by {c_number}[20|%+|]{/c} and the Vulnerable duration is increased by 4 seconds. You gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} Vulnerable Damage.

UberSubzone_Currency.desc: Obtained from defeating demonic forces, gathering nodes and completing events during a Helltide.

Helltide_BossSummon_Currency.desc: Obtained by opening Tortured Gifts during Helltide in World Tiers 3 and 4 only. Used to summon the Blood Maiden at the Accursed Ritual site.

Barbarian_DustDevils.desc: Dust Devils move in a straight line damaging enemies in their path and bouncing off walls.

Barbarian_Earthquake.desc: Ground effect that deals physical damage to enemies inside it over 4 seconds.

s2_temp_glyph_barb_001_a2_p.desc: You deal {c_number}13%{c_gray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage for {c_number}4{/c} seconds after creating a {c_important}Dust Devil{/c}.

s2_temp_glyph_barb_002_a2_p.desc: You deal {c_number}10%{c_gray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies and Bosses for each active {c_important}Earthquake{/c}.

s2_temp_glyph_druid_001_a2_p.desc: Enemies damaged by your {c_important}Lightning Bolts{/c} or {c_important}Dancing Bolts{/c} take {c_number}20%{c_gray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage from you for {c_number}5{/c} seconds.

s2_temp_glyph_necro_001_a2_p.desc: Consuming a Corpse {c_important}{u}Fortifies{/u}{/c} you for {c_number}4%{/c} of your Maximum Life and grants {c_number}4%{/c} Damage Reduction for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

s2_temp_glyph_necro_002_a2_p.desc: While standing in your {c_important}Desecrated Ground{/c}, you deal {c_number}15%{c_gray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased Shadow Damage.

s2_temp_glyph_rogue_001_a2_p.desc: Dropping a {c_important}Stun Grenade{/c} grants you {c_number}10%{/c} Damage Reduction for {c_number}2{/c} seconds.

s2_temp_glyph_rogue_002_a2_p.desc: Entering {c_important}{u}Stealth{/u}{/c} reduces the active cooldown of {c_important}Shadow Imbuement{/c} by {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

s2_temp_glyph_sorc_001_a2_p.desc: Your {c_important}Ice Spikes{/c} gain {c_number}10%{c_gray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} Critical Strike Chance.

s2_temp_glyph_sorc_002_a2_p.desc: Enemies damaged by your {c_important}Conjuration{/c} Skills deal {c_number}1%{/c} reduced damage to you for {c_number}6{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_number}12%{/c}.

s3_temp_stone_active_001.name: Autodefense
s3_temp_stone_active_001.desc:
{c_label}Speed: {/c}{c_number}1.5{/c} seconds
{c_label}Cooldown: {/c}{c_resource}25{/c} seconds
The Senechal Construct activates an antimaterial field around itself shooting down up to {c_number}30{/c} enemy projectiles. Lasts for {c_number}5.0{/c} seconds. Can not shoot down Boss or Player projectiles.
s3_temp_stone_active_001.source: Acquired by defeating Heralds in Arcane Tremors

s3_temp_stone_active_002.name: Bushwack
s3_temp_stone_active_002.desc: Quickly ambush dealing damage to each target. May strike the same target multiple times.

s3_temp_stone_active_003.name: Firefly
s3_temp_stone_active_003.desc: Deploy a small construct that lands on the target and explodes 3 times, dealing damage.

s3_temp_stone_active_004.name: Focus Fire
s3_temp_stone_active_004.desc:
{c_label}Speed: {/c}{c_resource}3.0{/c} seconds
The Seneschal Construct channels a ray of fire onto {c_number}2{/c} targets dealing {c_number}23,878{/c} total Fire damage to each of {c_number}3.0{/c} seconds.

s3_temp_stone_active_005.name: Gyrate
s3_temp_stone_active_005.desc:
{c_label}Speed: {/c}{c_resource}2.0{/c} seconds
The Seneschal Construct whirls its legs around quickly dealing {c_number}10,347{/c} Physical damage to all nearby enemies.

s3_temp_stone_active_006.name: Impale
s3_temp_stone_active_006.desc:
{c_label}Speed: {/c}{c_resource}1.5{/c} seconds
Perform a line attack to all enemies in front of the Seneschal Construct dealing {c_number}4,764{/c} damage.
s3_temp_stone_active_006.source: Acquired by defeating Heralds in Arcane Tremors

s3_temp_stone_active_007.name: Lightning Bolt
s3_temp_stone_active_007.desc: Launch a bolt of Lightning at the target dealing damage. Arcs to other targets dealing a portion of the original damage.

s3_temp_stone_active_008.name: Protect
s3_temp_stone_active_008.desc: The Seneschal Construct materializes a protective Barrier on the player for a portion of their Maximum Life.

s3_temp_stone_active_009.name: Reconstruct
s3_temp_stone_active_009.desc: The Seneschal Construct channels a reconstruction beam Healing the player for a portion of their Maximum Life over time.

s3_temp_stone_active_010.name: Slash
s3_temp_stone_active_010.desc: Pummel enemies in front of the Seneschal Construct dealing damage.

s3_temp_stone_active_011.name: Tempest
s3_temp_stone_active_011.desc: Electrically charge an enemy causing it to deal damage to themselves and additional each second over time. If the enemy is killed, Tempest spreads to another enemy gaining for additional time and bonus damage. These bonuses are also applied if Tempest is reapplied onto the same enemy.

s3_temp_stone_active_012.name: Flash of Adrenaline
s3_temp_stone_active_012.desc: Administers a quick flash of adrenaline into the player, granting bonus damage for a duration.

s3_temp_stone_support_001.name: Duration Support
s3_temp_stone_support_001.desc: Supported {c_important}Duration{/c} Skills have their durations increased by {c_number}4.0{/c} seconds.

s3_temp_stone_support_002.name: Arcing Support
s3_temp_stone_support_002.desc: The supported {c_important}Arcing{/c} Skill can hit {c_number}10{/c} additional enemies.

s3_temp_stone_support_003.name: Gripping Support
s3_temp_stone_support_003.desc: Damage and effects done by the supporting Skill to Distant enemies pulls them towards the Seneschal Construct. Can only occur once every {c_number}10{/c} seconds per enemy.

s3_temp_stone_support_004.name: Voluminous Support
s3_temp_stone_support_004.desc: The supported skill's effect size is increased by {c_number}50%{/c}.

s3_temp_stone_support_005.name: Fortify Support
s3_temp_stone_support_005.desc: When the Seneschal Construct uses the supported Skill, you gain {c_number}123{/c} {c_important}Fortify{/c}. Skills with slower attack speeds or skills with cooldowns will increase the amount of {c_important}Fortify{/c} granted.

s3_temp_stone_support_006.name: Initiative Support
s3_temp_stone_support_006.desc: The supported Skill will cause the Seneschal Construct to teleport to the target if out of range. Can only occur once every {c_number}3{/c} seconds.

s3_temp_stone_support_007.name: Safeguard Support
s3_temp_stone_support_007.desc: When used, the supported Skill grants {c_number}15.0%{/c} Damage Reduction to you for {c_number}3.0{/c} seconds.

s3_temp_stone_support_009.name: Evernight
s3_temp_stone_support_009.desc: The supported Skill grants you {c_number}+4{/c} to all Skills when used for {c_number}2.0{/c} seconds.
s3_temp_stone_support_009.source: Acquired by defeating the Echo of Malphas

s3_temp_stone_support_010.name: Breaking Support
s3_temp_stone_support_010.desc: Damage from the supported Skill instantly destroys enemy Barrier effects. In addition, there is a chance to make enemies Vulnerable for 2 seconds.

s3_temp_stone_support_011.name: Tactical Support
s3_temp_stone_support_011.desc: Decrease the cooldown of the supported Skill.

s3_temp_stone_support_012.name: Efficiency Support
s3_temp_stone_support_012.desc: When the supporting skill deals damage, you gain a {c_number}15%{/c} Critical Strike Chance to the same targets hit for {c_number}3.0{/c} seconds.

s3_temp_stone_support_013.name: Devastation Support
s3_temp_stone_support_013.desc: Supported Skill gains a {c_number}75%{/c} Critical Strike Damage bonus.

s3_temp_stone_support_014.name: Resource Support
s3_temp_stone_support_014.desc: Player gains {c_number}14{/c} Primary Resource when the supporting Skill first deals damage.

s3_temp_stone_support_015.name: Frigid Support
s3_temp_stone_support_015.desc: {c_number}50%{/c} of the supported Skill's damage dealt is applied as Cold damage over {c_number}5.0{/c} seconds and applies {c_number}35%{/c} Chill.

s3_temp_stone_support_016.name: Burning Support
s3_temp_stone_support_016.desc: {c_number}50%{/c} of the supported Skill's damage is applied as Burning damage over {c_number}5.0{/c} seconds. Burning enemies take {c_number}[40|%x|]{/c} bonus Critical Strike Damage from the Seneschal Construct.

s3_temp_stone_support_017.name: Electrocution Support
s3_temp_stone_support_017.desc: {c_number}50%{/c} of the supported skill's damage dealt is applied as Lightning damage over {c_number}5.0{/c} seconds and has a {c_number}15%{/c} chance to Stun enemies for {c_number}2{/c} seconds.

s3_temp_stone_support_018.name: Bleeding Support
s3_temp_stone_support_018.desc: {c_number}50%{/c} of the supported skill's damage dealt is applied as Bleeding damage over {c_number}5.0{/c} seconds. Enemies take {c_number}[30|%x|]{/c} bonus Bleeding damage from all sources while moving.

s3_temp_stone_support_019.name: Poison Support
s3_temp_stone_support_019.desc: A portion of the supported skill's damage dealt is applied as Poison damage over time. This poison has a chance each second to spread all Poison damage to an additional enemy.

s3_temp_stone_support_020.name: Dusk Support
s3_temp_stone_support_020.desc: A{c_number}50%{/c} of the supported Skill's damage dealt is applied as Shadow damage over {c_number}5.0{/c} seconds. Afflicted enemies who attack have a {c_number}15.0%{/c} chance for their attacks to be interrupted. Does not interrupt Bosses.

s3_temp_stone_support_021.name: Swift Support
s3_temp_stone_support_021.desc: The supported Skill gains a {c_number}40%{/c} Attack Speed bonus.

s3_temp_stone_support_022.name: Slowing Support
s3_temp_stone_support_022.desc: Damage from the supported Skill Slows enemy movement speed for {c_number}2{/c} seconds. The closer the enemy is to the Seneschal Construct, the greater the Slow amount. From {c_number}30%{/c} up to a maximum of {c_number}80%{/c} Slow to close enemies.

s3_temp_stone_support_023.name: Mockery Support
s3_temp_stone_support_023.desc: Damage done by the supporting Skill Taunts enemies hit for a {c_number}4.0{/c} seconds. This can only occur once every {c_number}15{/c} seconds per enemy. Does not work on bosses.

s3_temp_stone_support_024.name: Registered Damage Support
s3_temp_stone_support_024.desc: Any damage caused from the supported Skill is registered. The registered damage explodes at {c_number}50%{/c} effectiveness when the target dies as Fire damage.

s3_temp_stone_support_025.name: Multishot Support
s3_temp_stone_support_025.desc: Supported Projectile skills launch additional projectiles.

s3_temp_stone_support_026.name: Piercing Support
s3_temp_stone_support_026.desc: The supported {c_important}Projectile{/c} Skill will pierce up to 11 enemies.

s3_temp_stone_support_027.name: Seeking Support
s3_temp_stone_support_027.desc: The supported Projectile Skill will auto-seek enemies for a limited duration.

BloodSeal_Major_01.name: Metamorphosis
BloodSeal_Major_01.desc:
When you {c_important}Evade{/c} you turn into a cloud of bats, becoming {c_important}Unstoppable{/c} for {c_number}2.5{/c} seconds. Enemies along your path take {c_random}[Weapon_Damage_Min*(1+Main_Hand_Damage_Percent_Bonus)*(0.4+0.7*Max(1,GetBloodSealLevel(1530052)))|0|] - [(Weapon_Damage_Min+Weapon_Damage_Delta)*(1+Main_Hand_Damage_Percent_Bonus)*(0.4+0.7*Max(1,GetBloodSealLevel(1530052)))|0|]{/c} {c_advanced}[[100*(0.4+0.7*Max(1,GetBloodSealLevel(1530052)))|0|]%]{/c} Physical damage and are inflicted with {c_important}{u}Vampiric Curse.{/u}{/c}

{icon:bullet}Damage: {c_advanced}[110%]{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_advanced}[180%]{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_advanced}[250%]{/c}

BloodSeal_Major_05.name: Accursed Touch

BloodSeal_Major_06.name: Blood Boil

BloodSeal_Major_04.name: Bathe in Blood

BloodSeal_Major_02.name: Moonrise
BloodSeal_Major_02.desc:
Hitting an enemy with a {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill grants you {c_number}4.0%{/c} Attack Speed for {c_number}10{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_number}5{/c} times. Upon reaching maximum stacks, you enter a Vampiric Bloodrage, gaining {c_random}[(40+Max(1,GetBloodSealLevel(1555491))*40)/100*100|1|]%{/c}{c_gray}\[x\]{/c} {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill damage and {c_number}15.0%{/c} Movement Speed for {c_number}10{/c} seconds.

{icon:bullet}Damage: {c_random}80.0%{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_random}120.0%{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_random}160.0%{/c}
BloodSeal_Major_02.source: Acquired from "Battle of Fear and Faith" (Quest)

BloodSeal_Minor_01.name: Domination
BloodSeal_Minor_01.desc:
You deal {c_random}[(0.06+0.06*Max(1,GetBloodSealLevel(1561485)))*100|1|]%{/c}{c_gray}\[x\]{/c} increased damage to enemies who are {c_important}Stunned, Immobilized, {u}Frozen{/u},{/c} or Feared. If they're also {c_important}{u}Injured{/u}{/c} and not an Elite, they're instantly killed. 

{icon:bullet}Damage: {c_random}12.0%{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_random}18.0%{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_random}24.0%{/c}

BloodSeal_Minor_02.name: Undying
BloodSeal_Minor_02.desc:
Casting Skills heals you for {c_random}[(0.0075+0.0075*Max(1,GetBloodSealLevel(1561546)))*100|1|]%{/c} Life. Double this bonus while below {c_number}50%{/c} Life.

{icon:bullet}Heal: {c_random}1.5%{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_random}2.3%{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_random}3.0%{/c}

BloodSeal_Minor_03.name: Sanguine Brace

BloodSeal_Minor_04.name: Feed the Coven
BloodSeal_Minor_04.desc:
{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} {c_important}Conjuration, Companion, Minion{/c} and {c_important}Bat Familiar{/c} attacks have up to a {c_random}[15+15*Max(1,GetBloodSealLevel(1562097))|1|]%{/c} chance to restore {c_number}10{/c} Primary Resource to you and increase your Damage by {c_number}10.0%{/c}{c_gray}\[x\]{/c} for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

{icon:bullet}Chance: {c_random}30.0%{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_random}45.0%{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_random}60.0%{/c}

BloodSeal_Minor_05.name: Infection
BloodSeal_Minor_05.desc:
Hitting enemies with direct damage infects them with Pox. Inflicting Pox {c_number}8{/c} times on an enemy expunges their infection, dealing {c_random}[Weapon_Damage_Min*(1+Main_Hand_Damage_Percent_Bonus)*(0.1+0.2*Max(1,GetBloodSealLevel(1563146)))|0|] - [(Weapon_Damage_Min+Weapon_Damage_Delta)*(1+Main_Hand_Damage_Percent_Bonus)*(0.1+0.2*Max(1,GetBloodSealLevel(1563146)))|0|]{/c} {c_advanced}[[100*(0.1+0.2*Max(1,GetBloodSealLevel(1563146)))|0|]%]{/c} Poison damage.

{icon:bullet}Damage: {c_advanced}[30%]{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_advanced}[50%]{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_advanced}[70%]{/c}

BloodSeal_Minor_06.name: Anticipation

BloodSeal_Minor_07.name: Resilience
BloodSeal_Minor_07.desc:
You gain {c_number}1.0%{/c} Damage Reduction for each {c_random}[3.5-0.5*Max(1,GetBloodSealLevel(1563324))|1|]%{/c} Life you are missing.

{icon:bullet}Life Missing: {c_random}3.0%{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_random}2.5%{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_random}2.0%{/c}

BloodSeal_Mid_02.name: Ravenous
BloodSeal_Mid_02.source: Acquired from "A Witness in the Dust" (Quest)

BloodSeal_Mid_01.name: Prey on the Weak

BloodSeal_Mid_03.name: Hectic
BloodSeal_Mid_03.desc:
For every {c_number}5{/c} {c_important}Basic{/c} Skills you cast, one of your active Cooldowns is reduced by {c_random}[0.5+0.5*Max(1,GetBloodSealLevel(1564118))|1|]{/c} seconds.

{icon:bullet}Cooldown Reduction: {c_random}1.0{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_random}1.5{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_random}2.0{/c}

BloodSeal_Mid_04.name: Hemomancy

BloodSeal_Mid_05.name: Coven's Fangs

BloodSeal_Mid_06.name: Terror

BloodSeal_Mid_07.name: Rampart
BloodSeal_Mid_07.desc:
After not moving for {c_number}3{/c} seconds, you gain a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} for {c_random}[(0.1+0.1*Max(1,GetBloodSealLevel(1577825))+Barrier_Bonus_Percent-Barrier_Bonus_Percent)*100|1|]%{/c} of your Maximum Life for {c_number}6{/c} seconds. This effect can occur once every {c_number}20{/c} seconds.

{icon:bullet}Barrier: {c_random}20.0%{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_random}30.0%{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_random}40.0%{/c}

BloodSeal_Mid_08.name: Jagged Spikes
BloodSeal_Mid_08.desc:
Thorns has a {c_number}10.0%{/c} chance to deal {c_random}[(0.75+0.75*Max(1,GetBloodSealLevel(1580302)))*100|1|]%{/c}{c_gray}\[x\]{/c} increased damage and {c_important}{u}Chill{/u}{/c} enemies for {c_number}8.0%{/c}.  

{icon:bullet}Damage: {c_random}150.0%{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_random}225.0%{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_random}300.0%{/c}

BloodSeal_Major_03.name: Call Familiar
BloodSeal_Major_03.desc:
Casting a {c_important}Mastery, Weapon Mastery, Macabre, Wrath,{/c} or {c_important}Imbuement{/c} Skill calls a {c_important}Bat Familiar{/c} to attack nearby enemies, dealing {c_random}[Weapon_Damage_Min*(1+Main_Hand_Damage_Percent_Bonus)*(0.2+0.2*Max(1,GetBloodSealLevel(1581485)))|0|] - [(Weapon_Damage_Min+Weapon_Damage_Delta)*(1+Main_Hand_Damage_Percent_Bonus)*(0.2+0.2*Max(1,GetBloodSealLevel(1581485)))|0|]{/c} {c_advanced}[[100*(0.2+0.2*Max(1,GetBloodSealLevel(1581485)))|0|]%]{/c} Physical damage with a {c_number}30.0%{/c} chance to Stun.

{icon:bullet}Damage: {c_advanced}[40%]{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_advanced}[60%]{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_advanced}[80%]{/c}

BloodSeal_Major_07.name: Flowing Veins
BloodSeal_Major_07.desc:
You deal {c_random}[(0.15+0.15*Max(1,GetBloodSealLevel(1582723)))*100|1|]%{/c}{c_gray}\[x\]{/c} increased Damage Over Time to enemies that are moving or affected by a {c_important}{u}Vampiric Curse{/u}{/c}.

{icon:bullet}Damage: {c_random}30.0%{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_random}45.0%{/c} {icon:arrow} {c_random}60.0%{/c}
